title: Schools (Recording and Reporting of Seclusion and Restraint) (No. 2) (England) Regulations 2025

contributions.text: That this House regrets that the Schools (Recording and Reporting of Seclusion and Restraint) (No. 2) (England) Regulations 2025 are accompanied by an impact assessment that underestimates the cost of implementation; and that they do not enable the best use of the information which will be recorded by schools. Relevant document: 48th Report from the Secondary Legislation Scrutiny Committee
contributions.name: Lord Lucas
